shortDescription: Polymarket’s "T1 vs. BNK FEARX (BO5) - LCK Playoffs" market saw the "T1" option in the "match winner" submarket fall sharply from 92.5% one hour earlier to 77.5%, a 15 percentage point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects the impact of a sudden news event.
